name: cabin_interior
description: Starter-home interior of the log cabin (assets/buildings/cabin.png). Top-down 3/4 view; same palette, 32px grid and rules as manifest.json.
coords: ROOM pixel coords: origin = top-left of room_base.png. Rects are [x0, y0, x1, y1] inclusive. Sprites are drawn with their top-left at 'pos'.

art.comment: Smoothing off, integer zoom only (same as manifest.json). Sprites are transparent RGBA; contact shadows and fire glow are baked in as semi-transparent pixels.
art.intendedCharacterScale: Furniture is sized for a farmer roughly 1 tile wide and ~1.4 tiles tall (feet at bottom-center).

room.notes: Walls, plank floor, window (day view), stone fireplace + hearth, doorway with stone step. Transparent outside the walls. Room is smaller than most viewports: center it, no scrolling.

drawOrderNotes: ySorted = furniture + player (+ any pets/NPCs), sorted each frame by ySortLineY (furniture) vs feet Y (characters). Everything in earlier layers is always behind characters.

objects.notes: Log-frame bed, aguayo-striped wool blanket. Headboard overlaps the back wall (intended).
Pine table with a clay bowl of native potatoes and a clay cup.
Woven alpaca-wool rug, natural undyed colours, stepped-diamond motif. Walkable.
Totora reed mat by the door. Walkable.
Paper calendar (alpaca picture, 4 weeks x 7 days).
Knitted Andean chullo hat hanging on a wall peg. Decor only.
Kantuta flower in a clay pot on the window sill. Draw above window_night.
Horizontal strip, 4 frames. Includes semi-transparent glow on the firebox and hearth (alpha-blend it).
Covers only the 4 window panes (muntins left transparent). Day view is baked into room_base.

collision.notes: Solid = walls + fireplaceHearth + each object's 'collision'. Leave the doorway gap [128..159] open down to the exit trigger. Use a small feet hitbox for the player (~14x6 px).

walkableGrid.comment: Conservative tile-level approximation (9x8) for pathfinding/AI: a tile is blocked if any solid rect touches its central 16x16. '.' walkable, '#' blocked, 'D' exit. Use the rects for actual player movement.

exits.fireWhen: player feet hitbox overlaps trigger while moving down

exteriorLink.comment: Coords are in cabin.png pixels (64x64). World = cabin sprite's placed top-left + these values.
exteriorLink.enterWhen: player feet hitbox overlaps entryTrigger while moving up (or action button while facing up)
